record.question: The use of computer networks in hospital allows:
options: Sharing of patient data securely among departments
record.explanation: Computer networks can enable authorized, secure sharing of patient data among hospital departments when access controls and safeguards are configured; the other options are not appropriate purposes. Evidence: https://healthit.gov/health-it-basics/benefits-ehrs/ Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
